featuresPage.heading: The control center for user-driven trading automation
featuresPage.intro: Tragram combines a responsive mobile experience with a robust backend: execution decisions remain fully user-controlled, configurations sync instantly across devices, and the dashboard surfaces real-time system health.

coreFeatures.title: Real-time dashboard
coreFeatures.copy: Monitor account balance, equity, open trades, and key indicators in a single mobile-friendly view.
coreFeatures.detail: Clean layouts with position lists and actionable controls ensure critical data is always visible.

coreFeatures.title: Channel automation
coreFeatures.copy: Connect Telegram channels and execute signals conditionally while maintaining full control over symbols and risk limits.
coreFeatures.detail: Channel cards display signal history, preview upcoming orders, and provide quick access to automation controls.

coreFeatures.title: Reports & filtering
coreFeatures.copy: Analyze executed trades, evaluate performance, and export reports directly from the dashboard.
coreFeatures.detail: Filter by date, symbol, or channel, with quick export and sharing options.

securityFeatures.title: Authentication flow
securityFeatures.copy: Clear verification flows guide users through login with minimal friction.
securityFeatures.detail: Timers, helper text, and resend options ensure a consistent sign-in experience.

securityFeatures.title: Inline validation
securityFeatures.copy: Real-time validation reduces errors and keeps input data accurate.
securityFeatures.detail: Fields highlight issues instantly so users can correct them before submission.

securityFeatures.title: Plan & billing controls
securityFeatures.copy: Users can manage subscriptions directly from their profile, including upgrades, downgrades, and plan changes.
securityFeatures.detail: Billing details, renewal cycles, and actions are clearly displayed for full transparency.
